exposure: Bupivacaine plus dexmedetomidine for spinal anesthesia
outcome: postoperative pain relief (first analgesic requirement, pain intensity)
cohort: 60 eligible inpatients, pregnant women undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: The use of dexmedetomidine with Bupivacaine significantly reduced the need for analgesia compared to Bupivacaine alone.
